topic: What your blood pressure numbers mean

scenes.line: 120 over 80. What does that even mean?
scenes.visual: Blood pressure monitor screen with a big digital readout 120 over 80 and a small pulsing heart icon
scenes.animation: Screen powers on; '120' then '80' flick in digit by digit on '120' and '80'; question mark pops on 'mean'

scenes.line: The top number is the pressure when your heart pumps.
scenes.visual: Same readout; top number glows teal with label SYSTOLIC; heart icon squeezes
scenes.animation: Bottom number dims on 'top'; label slides in; heart squeezes on 'pumps'

scenes.line: The bottom number is the pressure when it rests between beats.
scenes.visual: Readout; bottom number glows with label DIASTOLIC; ECG line flattens between two beats
scenes.animation: Top number dims on 'bottom'; ECG line draws, pauses on 'rests', beats again on 'beats'

scenes.visual: Horizontal scale bar with three zones; the left zone lights up teal labelled NORMAL with 'under 120/80'
scenes.animation: Scale bar grows from the left; marker slides into the normal zone on 'normal'

scenes.line: 140 over 90 or higher, checked by a professional, is usually considered high.
scenes.visual: Same scale bar; right zone lights up in alert red labelled HIGH with '140/90 or higher'
scenes.animation: Marker slides to the right zone on 'high'; small stethoscope badge appears on 'professional'

scenes.line: In between? Guidelines differ by country, so ask your doctor what your target is.
scenes.visual: Middle zone of the scale lights apricot with a question mark; two small flag-free globe badges with different lines; speech bubble 'Ask your doctor'
scenes.animation: Marker settles in the middle on 'between'; globe badges pop on 'country'; bubble pops on 'doctor'

scenes.line: High blood pressure usually has no symptoms.
scenes.visual: A calm person outline with no warning signs around it; label 'Feels fine'
scenes.animation: Outline fades up; three faint warning icons appear and get crossed out on 'no symptoms'

scenes.line: The only way to know your numbers is to measure them.
scenes.visual: Blood pressure cuff icon connected to the monitor; readout shows dashes then fills in
scenes.animation: Cuff inflates (scale pulse) on 'measure'; readout dashes turn into a tick

scenes.line: Get yours checked at a pharmacy or your doctor's office, and save this for later.
scenes.visual: Two cards: pharmacy cross and clinic building; bookmark icon below
scenes.animation: Cards pop on 'pharmacy' and 'office'; bookmark bounces on 'save'

scenes.onScreenText: Not medical advice. Sources: NHS, CDC
